messages:
Nina (devex): quick repro: REST curl for embeddings succeeds but node SDK returns 400 on same data.
Nina (devex): curl:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{\"model\":\"rwd-embed-v1\",\"input\":\"how do I cancel\",\"meta\":{\"tenant\":\"acct-1\"}}'
```
Nina (devex): Node SDK minimal:
```js
await client.embeddings.create({model:'rwd-embed-v1', input:'how do I cancel', meta:{tenant:'acct-1'}})
```
Nina (devex): SDK error: "invalid meta". Captured outgoing body: meta is a JSON-string ("{\"tenant\":\"acct-1\"}") not an object.
Omar (sdk): that's a known serializer rule slip in v0.8.x where we stringify any nested object named `meta` for backwards compat. Shouldn't do that for embeddings.
Priya (qa): I can add a unit test asserting raw HTTP body equals expected object for embeddings/search/chat.
Omar (sdk): I'll patch serializer and also ensure Authorization header uses Bearer (found one place still emitting Token). Will add parity smoke tests that run curl vs sdk bodies.
ops-bot: created branch sdk/patch/meta-auth-fix-518 by omar 2020-11-05 CI queued.
Nina (devex): sample-apps quickstart hit a support ticket yesterday because of this. Please prioritize and ping me when released so I can update docs.
Omar (sdk): will aim for patch release today. PR will include deprecation note if any behavior changes.
Priya (qa): added tests to sdk CI job `sdk-parity` and a flaky guard for 48h after release.
Nina (devex): thanks team.
